name: mockup-studio
description: Local-first 3D device mockup studio for macOS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5175 && node scripts/brand-electron-dev.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5175 electron ."
scripts.dev:app: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5175 && node scripts/brand-electron-dev.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5175 electron .
scripts.dist:mac: MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct npm run build && MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct electron-builder --config electron-builder.direct.json --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct npm run build && MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct electron-builder --config electron-builder.direct.json --mac dmg zip --arm64 -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.dist:mac:universal: MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct npm run build && MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_direct electron-builder --config electron-builder.direct.json --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.dist:mac:mas: MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_mas npm run build && MOCKUP_DISTRIBUTION=mac_mas electron-builder --config electron-builder.mas.json --mac mas

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: mokstudio uses camera access to mirror your iPhone or iPad screen over USB into the 3D mockup.
